purpose: Parallel internet verification of five existing batch-51 examples while the same V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. This audit does not create a second runner, does not advance operation 291 and does not publish parcel values.

method.candidate_confidence_policy: Current identity confidence is reduced for address or postcode conflicts and for unavailable planning portals. Auction status is historical and is not promoted to legal completion or current availability.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical parcel geometry is read.
